techniques.name: Semantic entropy uncertainty
techniques.goal: Detect meaning-level answer instability rather than token-level variation
techniques.mechanism: Sample multiple answers, cluster semantically equivalent meanings, and compute entropy over meaning clusters.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use internally as escalation feature, not a user-facing confidence percentage.
risks: semantic clustering itself can be wrong

techniques.name: P(True) self-evaluation
techniques.goal: Estimate whether a proposed answer is likely correct
techniques.mechanism: After generating candidate answer, ask model to evaluate probability that answer is correct, optionally after seeing multiple alternative samples.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only one feature in uncertainty ensemble; calibrate locally.
risks: Same model shares blind spots with answer
verbal probability not stable across models

techniques.name: P(IK) know/unknown prediction
techniques.goal: Predict whether model likely knows enough before attempting full answer
techniques.mechanism: Ask/train self-assessment of probability of knowing answer independent of a specific candidate answer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Combine with task policy and evidence availability, never use alone.
avoid_when: OOD tasks where calibration is untested
risks: Can be overconfident on unfamiliar distributions

techniques.name: Post-hoc temperature calibration
techniques.goal: Map raw confidence/logits to probabilities better aligned with empirical correctness
techniques.mechanism: Fit a scalar temperature on held-out labeled calibration data.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Version calibration artifact with exact model/task distribution.
avoid_when: Free-form outputs without a meaningful base confidence
risks: Calibration can drift after distribution/model change

techniques.name: Reliability diagrams + ECE/Brier diagnostics
techniques.goal: Measure whether confidence corresponds to empirical correctness
techniques.mechanism: Bin or score confidence/outcome pairs and inspect calibration error/proper scoring rule.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Never ship confidence score without a calibration report for intended task.
risks: ECE depends on binning and can hide subgroup error

techniques.name: Selective prediction / reject option
techniques.goal: Trade coverage for lower error on answered/automated cases
techniques.mechanism: Only answer/act when confidence/evidence exceeds threshold; otherwise abstain, retrieve, escalate or ask user.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Risk class determines acceptable coverage/error tradeoff.
avoid_when: User requires best-effort answer and harmless uncertainty is acceptable
techniques.cost_profile: usually reduces error at cost of coverage

techniques.name: Conformal prediction / calibrated prediction sets
techniques.goal: Produce sets/abstention regions with empirical coverage guarantees under stated assumptions
techniques.mechanism: Use held-out calibration nonconformity scores to choose prediction set/threshold satisfying target coverage.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential strong gate for stable Agent OS classifiers, not magic confidence for arbitrary generation.
risks: Guarantee is conditional on assumptions and correctness definition

techniques.name: Uncertainty-triggered information gathering
techniques.goal: Ask the most informative question instead of guessing
techniques.mechanism: Estimate uncertainty over possible states and expected information gain of candidate questions/actions; choose one reducing decision uncertainty most.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Combine with value-of-information and interruption-cost policy.
avoid_when: Question has high interruption cost and decision does not depend on answer
risks: Simulation may invent wrong possible worlds

techniques.name: Uncertainty ensemble
techniques.goal: Reduce dependence on any one unreliable confidence signal
techniques.mechanism: Combine calibrated features such as retrieval support, validator results, semantic entropy, model disagreement, self-eval, OOD indicators and task risk.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use simple interpretable model initially; preserve feature-level contributions.
avoid_when: No outcome data to calibrate combination

techniques.name: Coverage-guided fuzz testing
techniques.goal: Discover unexpected parser/state/code failures automatically
techniques.mechanism: Mutate corpus inputs while using execution coverage to retain mutations exploring new paths; crash/exception becomes regression seed.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Fuzz deterministic boundaries around LLM systems heavily.
avoid_when: Expensive nondeterministic model calls as direct fuzz target
risks: Low semantic validity for structured inputs

techniques.name: Structure-aware fuzzing
techniques.goal: Reach deep code paths for complex structured inputs
techniques.mechanism: Use grammar/schema-aware generators or custom mutators instead of random bytes.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Generate both valid and near-valid payloads.
risks: Generator may encode same assumptions as implementation

techniques.name: Fuzz-corpus minimization
techniques.goal: Keep a compact regression corpus that preserves discovered coverage/failures
techniques.mechanism: Minimize inputs/corpus while retaining code coverage or failure behavior.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Promote minimal reproducer to regression suite with source failure link.
risks: Coverage equivalence may drop semantic diversity

techniques.name: Metamorphic testing
techniques.goal: Test systems lacking exact output oracle through relations that should hold under transformed inputs
techniques.mechanism: Define semantics-preserving or predictably changing transformations and assert output/state relation rather than exact answer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Excellent source of robust evals for probabilistic systems.
risks: Invalid relation can label good behavior as failure

techniques.name: Paraphrase invariance testing
techniques.goal: Detect brittle behavior under semantically equivalent wording
techniques.mechanism: Generate/curate meaning-preserving prompt paraphrases and require invariant core answer/action/schema.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Human/semantic checker validates high-value relation set.
avoid_when: Style/writing tasks where wording legitimately changes output

techniques.name: Transformation robustness testing
techniques.goal: Find sensitivity to irrelevant presentation changes
techniques.mechanism: Apply formatting, order, casing, benign noise, whitespace, document-layout or equivalent representation transformations and test invariant properties.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Build domain-specific relation library from actual failures.
avoid_when: Presentation is part of intended signal

techniques.name: Differential testing across implementations/models
techniques.goal: Find discrepancies without knowing the correct answer a priori
techniques.mechanism: Run same case through multiple implementations/providers/configurations and investigate disagreements.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Disagreement triggers investigation/strong oracle, not majority vote.
avoid_when: All implementations share same bug/training lineage

techniques.name: Cross-provider behavioral differential testing
techniques.goal: Detect model-specific brittle assumptions in Agent OS scaffolds
techniques.mechanism: Run identical task/tool/context contract on multiple eligible providers and compare constraint/tool/state behavior.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Required before swapping default provider/model.

techniques.name: Differential specification testing
techniques.goal: Use natural-language spec + multiple implementations to generate tests targeting likely discrepancies
techniques.mechanism: Model reads spec/code differences, proposes high-information test cases, then actual implementations provide observable outputs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong future tool for provider adapters and migration code.
use_when: Multiple adapters implementing same Agent OS contract
risks: LLM can misread spec; implementation difference may be intentional

techniques.name: Symbolic execution test generation
techniques.goal: Generate path-covering test inputs using program constraints rather than random mutation
techniques.mechanism: Execute code symbolically, fork on branches, solve path constraints to reach unexplored states.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use selectively on small critical native/core components.
avoid_when: Python code unsupported by chosen engine

techniques.name: Static semantic analysis
techniques.goal: Find bug/vulnerability patterns without executing generated code
techniques.mechanism: Parse/index control/data flow and run queries/rules over source code.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run before model reviewer where supported; feed precise findings to repair loop.

techniques.name: Runtime sanitizers
techniques.goal: Detect memory/undefined behavior during tests/fuzzing
techniques.mechanism: Compile/instrument native code with ASan/UBSan/etc. and run generated/regression inputs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Enable in fuzz/CI variants, not necessarily production.

techniques.name: Property-based generated testing
techniques.goal: Explore broad input/state space from invariants instead of handpicked examples
techniques.mechanism: Define generators and properties; automatically generate cases and shrink failures.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every deterministic Agent OS subsystem should expose properties where possible.

techniques.name: State-machine property testing
techniques.goal: Explore sequences of actions and state transitions, not only individual inputs
techniques.mechanism: Generate command sequences against model/reference state machine and compare postconditions/invariants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Especially valuable for interruption/resume and approval transitions.
risks: Reference model can share design error

techniques.name: Mutation testing of test/eval suite
techniques.goal: Measure whether tests are capable of catching plausible defects
techniques.mechanism: Inject small code/config/prompt mutations and measure how many are detected by existing suite.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Can mutate prompts/tool schemas too, not just code.

techniques.name: Prompt mutation testing
techniques.goal: Determine whether evals catch accidental prompt regressions
techniques.mechanism: Automatically delete/reorder/negate/weaken individual prompt requirements/examples and require eval/security suite to fail appropriately.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong defense against eval suites that only rubber-stamp changes.
risks: Some harmless changes counted as mutants

techniques.name: Tool-schema fuzz testing
techniques.goal: Find parser/validator/authorization edge cases before an LLM discovers them accidentally
techniques.mechanism: Generate malformed, boundary, oversized, contradictory, extra-field and type-confused tool payloads.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Seed fuzzer from real schemas and prior failed calls.
risks: Doesn't test semantic model misuse alone

techniques.name: Agent state/event fuzzing
techniques.goal: Find orchestration bugs from rare event sequences
techniques.mechanism: Generate/reorder/drop/duplicate delay-safe synthetic events and transitions under state-machine invariants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run only on simulated/fixture side effects.
avoid_when: External real side effects not isolated
risks: Unrealistic event schedules can create noise

techniques.name: Adversarial prompt/property fuzzing
techniques.goal: Systematically mutate user/untrusted strings to discover instruction-boundary and parser failures
techniques.mechanism: Generate encodings, nesting, delimiters, injections, oversized inputs and semantic mutations while checking security invariants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Security suite owns invariant; model-generated attacks are just input generator.
risks: Attack generator can miss novel classes

techniques.name: Test-case shrinking / minimal reproducer generation
techniques.goal: Make discovered failures understandable and durable
techniques.mechanism: Delta-debug or property-testing shrink failing input/sequence while preserving failure.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store minimal case + original case provenance.
risks: Shrink can remove semantically meaningful context

techniques.name: Failure-seed regression corpus
techniques.goal: Ensure every meaningful discovered bug becomes permanently replayable
techniques.mechanism: Persist minimized fuzz/property/metamorphic/production failures as versioned regression fixtures.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Private failures stay local; sanitized mechanisms become canonical tests.
